notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
You have an additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling a number of cards equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Specimen Collector encore until end of turn.
Activate Specimen Collector's encore ability by paying {4}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Each Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel and 0/3 Crab creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Specimen Collector token, adding one mana of any color.
The Specimen Collector token dies, creating a token copy of a Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 3.
